name: Task
about: A unit of planned work (one branch, one PR)

**Phase:** 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6

**Goal**
What this task delivers, in one or two sentences.

**Done when**
- [ ] Concrete, checkable criterion
- [ ] Results or logs saved under `results/` (if applicable)

**AI use**
Prompts used and where they are logged in `docs/ai-process-log.md` (or "none").
